app.name: Tajweed
app.tagline: The Noble Quran and Its Sciences

firstLaunch.later: You can change this later in Settings
firstLaunch.draft: Interface translation by the project. Found a mistake? Report it on GitHub.

search.placeholder: Search a word, a surah or an ayah number
search.kindWord: A word, with or without tashkeel
search.withTashkeel: You typed tashkeel, so it had to match.

actions.title: Ayah actions
actions.allTafsirs: All the tafsirs of this ayah

markers.title: Ayah markers
markers.tintNote: The colour covers the ayah and its number.

common.noRemind: No reminder — the only notification is the adhan.

player.modeEndless: To the end, then from Al-Fatihah again
player.reconnectNote: The connection dropped: the same source is tried again, then the next one, without end — nothing for you to do.
player.listeningOnly: Listening only — the text shown is in the riwayah of Hafs from Asim
player.wholeSurahs: This recitation plays whole surahs only.
player.streamingOnly: Streaming only: downloading waits for the source’s permission.

radio.note: Only streams that the broadcaster itself publishes.

hadith.arabicOnly: No published translation in this language: shown in Arabic.
hadith.notLoaded: The hadiths have not been loaded on the server yet.

sources.sub: Everything the app uses, and where it comes from

prayer.calcNote: Times are calculated on your device from your location; your location is never sent to a server. The method follows your country automatically, and you can change it.
prayer.lastThird: The last third of the night
prayer.noLocation: The location is not available. Allow it in the browser, or enter it below.
prayer.methodDefault: No official method has been read for your country yet: the Muslim World League’s is used.

qibla.web: On a computer there is no compass: the direction is shown in degrees.
qibla.calc: Calculated on your device, from your location to the Kaaba.

hijri.note: Umm al-Qura calendar. Adjust it by a day or two to match your country's announcement.

hifz.days: Today · after 1 day · after 3 days · after 7 days
hifz.reveal: Tap a hidden word to show it.

khatma.finished: The khatma is complete — may Allah accept it from you

notes.empty: No notes yet. Add one from an ayah's actions (tap the ayah).

kids.repeat: Listen and repeat after the reciter
kids.lettersAudio: The letters' sounds are added once a named source for them is chosen.

zakat.noInheritance: No inheritance calculator: inheritance needs a scholar.
zakat.intro: Each body's ruling is shown under its own name, with its fatwas; the app does not choose between them.
zakat.scope: For money and savings only; gold you own, jewellery, trade goods and debts have their own rulings in the fatwas.
zakat.prices: Type today's prices in your own currency — the app does not fetch prices.
zakat.gold24: One gram of pure gold (24 carat)
zakat.saudi: Saudi Arabia — the Permanent Committee and the Council of Senior Scholars
zakat.egyptRule: Nisab: the value of 85 grams of 21-carat gold.
zakat.saudiRule: Nisab of money: the lower of the two nisabs — the value of 85 grams of pure gold or of 595 grams of pure silver.
zakat.saudiGrams: The grams are those of Ibn Uthaymeen and the seminars on contemporary zakat issues; Shaykh Ibn Baz gave the gold nisab as 92 grams.
zakat.rate: When the money reaches the nisab and a full Hijri year passes over it: 2.5%.
zakat.needPrices: Type the prices above to see the nisab.
zakat.below: Below the nisab — no zakat is due on it.

settings.fileNote: Settings, markers, notes and progress — there are no accounts.
settings.badFile: This is not a Tajweed settings file.

directions.mountains: Mountains — for low vision and colour blindness

about.title: About
about.unreachable: The server cannot be reached right now.

tafsir.none: No tafsir is available for this ayah yet.

privacy.draft: Draft — published in its final form before the first release.
privacy.languages: The privacy policy is published in Arabic and English.
